Songal's Elemental Suffusion.name: Songal's Elemental Suffusion
Songal's Elemental Suffusion.description:
You imbue yourself with the elemental power of genies. You gain the following benefits until the spell ends:

  • Elemental Immunity. When you cast this spell, choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. You have @variantrule[Resistance|XPHB] to the chosen damage type.

  • Elemental Pulse. When you cast this spell and at the start of each of your subsequent turns, you release a burst of elemental energy in a 15-foot @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] originating from yourself. Each creature of your choice in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/damage 2d6]] Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) and has the &Reference[condition=Prone] condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

  • Flight. You gain a @variantrule[Fly Speed|XPHB] of 30 feet and can hover.

Casting as a Circle Spell. If the spell is cast as a Circle spell, its casting time increases to 1 minute, and its duration increases to @status[Concentration|XPHB], up to 10 minutes. For each secondary caster who participates in the casting, you can choose one additional creature, to a maximum of nine additional creatures. The chosen creatures also gain the benefits of the spell for its duration.

When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a level 2+ spell slot; otherwise, the spell fails.

Backlash.name: Backlash
Backlash.description:
You ward yourself against destructive energy, reducing the damage taken by [[/r 4d6]] plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

If the triggering damage was from a creature within range, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes [[/damage 4d6 type=force]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage reduction and Force damage from this spell both increase by [[/damage 1d6]] for every spell slot level above 4.

Doomtide.name: Doomtide
Doomtide.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere] of inky fog within range. The fog is magical @variantrule[Darkness|XPHB] and lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by the @spell[Gust of Wind|XPHB] spell) disperses it, ending the spell.

Each creature in the @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere] when it appears makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/damage 5d6 type=psychic]] damage and subtracts [[/r 1d6]] from its saving throws until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere] moves into its space, when it enters the @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere], or when it ends its turn inside the @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere]. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

The @variantrule[Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere] moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

Casting as a Circle Spell. Casting this as a Circle spell requires a minimum of five secondary casters. In addition to the spell's usual components, you must provide a special component (a string of three black pearls from Pandemonium), which the spell consumes. The spell's range increases to 1 mile, and its duration increases to until dispelled (no @status[Concentration|XPHB] required). The spell ends early if any caster who participated in this casting contributes to another casting of @spell[Doomtide|FRHoF] as a Circle spell.

When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a level 3+ spell slot; otherwise, the spell fails.

Dirge.name: Dirge
Dirge.description:
Deathly power fills a 60-foot @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] originating from you for the duration.

When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it. Any other creature can't regain @variantrule[Hit Points|XPHB] while in the @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation]. Whenever the @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] or ends its turn there, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes [[/damage 3d10 type=necrotic]] damage and has the &Reference[condition=Prone] condition. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and its @variantrule[Speed|XPHB] is halved. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Casting as a Circle Spell. Casting this as a Circle spell requires a minimum of two secondary casters. If the spell is cast as a Circle spell, its duration becomes @status[Concentration|XPHB], up to 10 minutes.

A creature that fails its save against the spell's effect also gains 1 &Reference[condition=Exhaustion] level. While the creature has &Reference[condition=Exhaustion] levels, finishing a @variantrule[Long Rest|XPHB] neither restores lost @variantrule[Hit Points|XPHB] nor reduces the creature's &Reference[condition=Exhaustion] level.

When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a level 4+ spell slot; otherwise, the spell fails.

Syluné's Viper.name: Syluné's Viper
Syluné's Viper.description:
A shimmering, spectral snake encircles your body for the duration. You gain 15 @variantrule[Temporary Hit Points|XPHB]; the spell ends early if you have no @variantrule[Temporary Hit Points|XPHB] left.

While the spell is active, you gain the following benefits:

  • Climbing. You gain a @variantrule[Climb Speed|XPHB] equal to your @variantrule[Speed|XPHB].

  • Venomous Bite. As a @action[Magic|XPHB] action, you can make a ranged spell attack using the snake against one creature within 50 feet. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 1d6 type=force]] damage and has the &Reference[condition=Poisoned] condition until the start of your next turn. While &Reference[condition=Poisoned], the target has the &Reference[condition=Incapacitated] condition.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. For each spell slot level above 3, the number of @variantrule[Temporary Hit Points|XPHB] you gain from this spell increases by 5, and the damage of Venomous Bite increases by [[/damage 1d6]].

Spellfire Flare.name: Spellfire Flare
Spellfire Flare.description:
You unleash a blast of brilliant fire. Make a ranged spell attack against a target within range; a target gains no benefit from @variantrule[Cover|XPHB|Half Cover] or @variantrule[Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover] for this attack roll. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 2d10 type=radiant]] damage.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. You create an additional blast for each spell slot level above 1. You can direct the blasts at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each blast.

Alustriel's Mooncloak.name: Alustriel's Mooncloak
Alustriel's Mooncloak.description:
For the duration, moonlight fills a 20-foot @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] originating from you with @variantrule[Dim Light|XPHB]. While in that area, you and your allies have @variantrule[Cover|XPHB|Half Cover] and @variantrule[Resistance|XPHB] to Cold, Lightning, and Radiant damage.

While the spell lasts, you can use one of the following options, ending the spell immediately:

  • Liberation. When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the &Reference[condition=Frightened], &Reference[condition=Grappled], or &Reference[condition=Restrained] condition, you can take a @variantrule[Reaction|XPHB] to succeed on the save instead.

  • Respite. As a @action[Magic|XPHB] action, you or an ally within the area regains @variantrule[Hit Points|XPHB] equal to [[/r 4d10]] plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Spellfire Storm.name: Spellfire Storm
Spellfire Storm.description:
You conjure a pillar of spellfire in a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high @variantrule[Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder] centered on a point within range. The area of the @variantrule[Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder] is @variantrule[Bright Light|XPHB], and each creature in it when it appears makes a Constitution saving throw, taking [[/damage 4d10 type=radiant]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

In addition, whenever a creature in the @variantrule[Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder] casts a spell, that creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, @variantrule[Bonus Action|XPHB], or @variantrule[Reaction|XPHB] used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it.

Casting as a Circle Spell. In addition to the spell's usual components, you must provide a special component (a blue star sapphire worth 25,000+ GP), which the spell consumes. The spell's range increases to 1 mile, and it no longer requires @status[Concentration|XPHB]. When the spell is cast, each secondary caster must expend a level 3+ spell slot; otherwise, the spell fails.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by [[/damage 1d10]] for every spell slot level above 4.

The number of secondary casters determines the spell's area of effect and duration, as shown in the table below. The spell ends early if any caster who participated in this casting contributes to another casting of Spellfire Storm as a Circle spell.

Secondary CastersArea of EffectDuration
1-340-foot-radius, 40-foot-high @variantrule[Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder]1 Hour

Deryan's Helpful Homunculi.name: Deryan's Helpful Homunculi
Deryan's Helpful Homunculi.description:
You summon a group of helpful spirits, which lasts for the duration. The spirits appear as homunculi or as another Construct of your choice but are intangible and invulnerable, and they are considered to have proficiency in the &Reference[skill=Arcana] skill and with the set of @item[Artisan's Tools|XPHB] used in the spell's casting.

If you are crafting an item, the spirits function as a single assistant for your crafting, halving the crafting time.

Holy Star of Mystra.name: Holy Star of Mystra
Holy Star of Mystra.description:
You create a glowing mote of energy that hovers above you for the duration. The mote sheds @variantrule[Bright Light|XPHB] in a 5-foot radius and @variantrule[Dim Light|XPHB] for an additional 5 feet.

When you cast this spell and as a @variantrule[Bonus Action|XPHB] on later turns, you can unleash a shining bolt from the mote, targeting one creature within 120 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes Force or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to [[/r 4d10]] plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

In addition, while the mote is present, you have @variantrule[Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover], and if you succeed on a saving throw against a spell of level 7 or lower that targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a @variantrule[Reaction|XPHB] to deflect that spell back at the spell's caster; the caster makes a saving throw against that spell using that caster's own spell save DC.

Wardaway.name: Відведення захисту
Wardaway.description:
Ви спрямовуєте дезорієнтуючу магічну силу на одну істоту в межах дистанції. Ціль здійснює рятівний кидок Статури (Constitution); Конструкти (Constructs) та Нежить (Undead) автоматично проходять цей кидок.

У разі провалу ціль отримує [[/damage 2d4 type=force]] силової шкоди, її швидкість (@variantrule[Speed|XPHB]) зменшується вдвічі до початку вашого наступного ходу, а на своєму наступному ході вона може виконати лише дію або бонусний рух (@variantrule[Bonus Action|XPHB]) (але не те й інше одночасно). У разі успіху ціль отримує лише половинну шкоду.

Використання комірки вищого рівня. Шкода збільшується на [[/damage 2d4]] за кожен рівень комірки заклинання вище 1-го.

Cacophonic Shield.name: Cacophonic Shield
Cacophonic Shield.description:
Thunderous reverberations fill a 10-foot @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] originating from you for the duration. Whenever the @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the @variantrule[Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation] or ends its turn there, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes [[/damage 3d6 type=thunder]] damage and has the &Reference[condition=Deafened] condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn. When you cast this spell, you can designate creatures to be unaffected by it.

In addition, you have @variantrule[Resistance|XPHB] to Thunder damage, and ranged attack rolls against you are made with @variantrule[Disadvantage|XPHB].

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by [[/damage 1d6]] for each spell slot level above 3.

Elminster's Elusion.name: Elminster's Elusion
Elminster's Elusion.description: Arcane wards protect you against magic for the duration. You have @variantrule[Advantage|XPHB] on saving throws against spells and magical effects. Additionally, if you succeed on a saving throw against a spell or magical effect and would normally take half as much damage, you instead take no damage.

Blade of Disaster.name: Blade of Disaster
Blade of Disaster.description:
You create a 3-foot-long blade-shaped planar rift that lasts for the duration. The rift appears within range in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make up to two melee spell attacks, each one against a creature or object within 5 feet of the rift. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 10d6 type=force]] damage. This attack scores a @variantrule[Critical Hit|XPHB] if the number on the [[/r d20]] is 18 or higher.

As a @variantrule[Bonus Action|XPHB] on your later turns, you can move the rift up to 60 feet and repeat the two attacks against a creature or an object within 5 feet of it. You can direct the attacks at the same target or at different ones.

The blade can harmlessly pass through any barrier, including ones created by spells like @spell[Wall of Force|XPHB].

Conjure Constructs.name: Conjure Constructs
Conjure Constructs.description:
You conjure a group of intangible, orderly spirits that appear as a Medium group of modrons or other Constructs in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirits last for the duration. When you cast this spell and as a @action[Magic|XPHB] action on subsequent turns, you can command the spirits to target one creature or object you can see within 5 feet of the spirits and create one of the following effects:

  • Clockwork Force. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking [[/damage 3d6 type=force]] damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

  • Orderly Ward. The target gains @variantrule[Temporary Hit Points|XPHB] equal to [[/r 1d6]] plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

When you move on your turn, you can also move the spirits up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage and @variantrule[Temporary Hit Points|XPHB] both increase by [[/damage 1d6]] for each spell slot level above 3.

Elminster's Effulgent Spheres.name: Elminster's Effulgent Spheres
Elminster's Effulgent Spheres.description:
Six chromatic spheres orbit you for the duration.

While the spheres are present, you can expend spheres to create the following effects:

  • Absorb Energy. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can take a @variantrule[Reaction|XPHB] to expend one sphere and give yourself @variantrule[Resistance|XPHB] to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn.

  • Energy Blast. As a @variantrule[Bonus Action|XPHB], you send one sphere hurtling toward a target within 120 feet of yourself. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes [[/damage 3d6]] Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice). Regardless of whether you hit, the sphere is expended.

The spell ends early if you have no more spheres remaining.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The number of spheres increases by 1 for every spell slot level above 6.

Death Armor.name: Death Armor
Death Armor.description: For the duration, an inky aura surrounds one creature you touch. The target has @variantrule[Advantage|XPHB] on @variantrule[Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws], and once per turn, when a creature within 5 feet of the target hits it with a melee attack roll, the attacker takes [[/damage 2d4 type=necrotic]] damage.

Simbul's Synostodweomer.name: Simbul's Synostodweomer
Simbul's Synostodweomer.description: You imbue one creature you touch with magical healing energy for the duration. Whenever the target casts a spell using a spell slot, the target can immediately roll a number of unexpended @variantrule[Hit Point Dice|XPHB] equal to the spell slot's level and regain @variantrule[Hit Points|XPHB] equal to the roll's total plus your spellcasting ability modifier; those dice are then expended.

Laeral's Silver Lance.name: Laeral's Silver Lance
Laeral's Silver Lance.description:
Silver energy bursts out from you in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide @variantrule[Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line]. Each creature of your choice in the @variantrule[Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line] makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes [[/damage 3d10 type=force]] damage and has the &Reference[condition=Prone] condition. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by [[/damage 1d10]] for every spell slot level above 3.
